summary: @servicetitan/data-query ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing 727 KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with _0x-hex identifiers and string-lookup indirection; it downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js in the package directory. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) protected by obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (function WV8StW rotates array n7gIxM) with hex-mangled identifiers throughout, so its behavior cannot be inspected by Node-based static analysis. dist/index.js re-exports a benign @progress/kendo-data-query-shaped API surface (isCompositeFilterDescriptor, toODataString, orderBy, filterBy, groupBy,...), unrelated to the install-time dropper — a library-shaped cover over the preinstall payload. The `@servicetitan` scope name mimics ServiceTitan's public GitHub org while shipping install-time behavior a data-query library has no legitimate need for. Installing the package causes Bun to execute the obfuscated payload with the installer's privileges before any user code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
